messages:
megan: FYI — Cypress Health wants a POC for a new variant (cypress-16b-slim-adapt). Use case: clinician triage chat + long-context embeddings. PHI involved. They asked if we can onboard and what timeline + rough cost for ~100M gen tokens + 6M embed tokens/mo.

harry: cypress-16b-slim-adapt isn't in our catalog today. We can onboard but need: model weights (HF or presigned S3), tokenizer files, license/redistribution terms, ~1k representative prompts, a couple of long-doc samples, and expected max_context. Also ask for desired latency SLO.

zoe: From infra/ML: slim/adapt suggests we should prepare quantized candidates (q4_k, q5_k). For long-context (>=16k) validate KV cache behavior and memory-per-token. If they insist on 32k, that's additional kernel tuning and changes GPU sizing.

luna: Security/legal: PHI requires Dedicated or Private deployment with BAA. We'll also require KMS-managed keys for data at-rest, audit logs, and network isolation. Need their DPO contact and a simple data flow diagram. Legal addendum for BAA ~2-3 weeks — potential blocker for go-live.

legal-bot: questionnaire received and uploaded to deal binder. Please attach data flow diagram.

pricing-bot: Quick note on cost: hosted list rates for that volume add up. Two options to lower unit cost: (1) committed Dedicated capacity with monthly commit, or (2) hybrid routing (embeddings to hosted, heavy gen to Dedicated). I can draft a committed vs hosted sketch after we get peak concurrent streams and avg tokens/response.

megan: Customer asked if we can do model validation in 5 business days after artifact handoff. Is that realistic?

infra-bot: Basic checks (tokenizer roundtrip + smoke forward + perf sweep start) — 3 business days if artifacts are clean. Full quality/safety eval + medical extraction checks — +2 days. If 32k tuning required +3 days. So optimistic 5 business days, realistic 7-8 business days end-to-end unless legal delays.

zoe: I can own the perf/quant sweep. Please provide a presigned s3 link with read-only access. Ill run candidates on A100 + H100 and post a small perf matrix (latency, p99, mem per token).

harry: Short tokenizer check for the customer to run locally (send in onboarding checklist):
```
python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('path/to/tokenizer'); s=open('samples.txt').read().splitlines()[:200]; ids=[t(x)['input_ids'] for x in s]; print('avg_len', sum(len(i) for i in ids)/len(ids))"
```
And a minimal forward smoke test:
```
python -c "import torch; from model_loader import load_model; m=load_model('path/to/model'); x=torch.randint(0,32000,(1,128)); out=m(x); print(getattr(out,'shape', 'ok'))"
```
These catch tokenizer mismatches and missing weights.

megan: I'll request artifacts, 1k prompts, long-docs, peak concurrent streams, and avg tokens/response. Also uploading their security questionnaire to the deal binder and looping in their DPO.

pricing-bot: Once we have peak rps and avg seq length I'll post a hosted vs committed cost comparison and a rough SLA pricing delta.

luna: Add to checklist: embeddings retention policy, who can access indices, and whether they plan to export indices outside their account — encrypted indices required if PHI.

zoe: small note: if tokenizer has custom special tokens or a different vocab, we may need a quick adapter step which can add a day. Flagging it now.

megan: Thanks — scheduling a customer sync for Friday. Ill update the deal doc with the checklist and timeline estimates.
